eps.t: We Are Justice! The Dragon Keepers!
eps.ov: Tired of the Sunday Showdown charade, Fighter D decides to defeat the Rangers for real this time.
Fighter D reunites with Yumeko Suzukiri, who approaches him with an unexpected proposal.
Fighter D decides to infiltrate the Red Garrison with Yumeko, only to find himself in a tight spot.
In pursuit of Fighter D, Aran Hekiru, a Blue Junior Third Rank, discovers his connection to Hibiki.

eps.t: Fighter D, as a Part of “Ranger Force”
eps.ov: Fighter D infiltrates the White Dragon's Nest in disguise and discovers someone in hiding.
Fighter D and Kai Shion work together to face off against Shun Tokita in the final exam.

eps.t: The Zigzag Road to the Final Exam!
eps.ov: Fighter D's plans go awry as Shion works with the other cadets on the second day of the exam.
Peltrola sneaks into the White Dragon's Nest, and meets Komachi Aizome of the Blue Squadron.
Fighter XX steps in to help Fighter D but is stopped by Blue Keeper with his Divine Artifact.
Peltrola retreats after an all-out fight with Blue Keeper, but is halted by the Junior First Ranks.

eps.t: On the Road to My Justice!
eps.ov: The cadets, Junior First Ranks, and Blue Keeper team up against Peltrola and their clones.
Fighter D engages in a head-to-head fight with Blue Keeper despite his overwhelming disadvantage.
